policy: Do not use v12 for model, representation, threshold, margin, hybrid-rule, or architecture selection.
Do not describe v12 as blind, untouched, or fresh evidence.
Develop and calibrate the next candidate only on development/calibration evidence.
Freeze the complete candidate configuration before any post-selection stress evaluation.
Use a separately generated one-shot corpus for the next fresh-holdout claim.
rationale: The exact v12 corpus was generated and structurally inspected by the same optimization agent before the next architecture was selected.
v12 may be used only as a design-known stress/validation set after a candidate is frozen; it must not support a claim of blind fresh-holdout generalization.
The next blind final evaluation must be generated only after the candidate configuration is frozen and then executed once without intermediate inspection.
